claimText: The James Webb Space Telescope launched on December 25, 2021

brave.title: James Webb Space Telescope Launches on Christmas Day 2021
brave.description: NASA's James Webb Space Telescope launched on an Ariane 5 rocket from Europe's Spaceport in French Guiana on December 25, 2021 at 7:20 a.m. EST.

brave.title: Webb Telescope: The most powerful space telescope ever built
brave.description: The James Webb Space Telescope successfully launched on Christmas morning 2021, beginning its journey to the L2 Lagrange point 1.5 million kilometers from Earth.

brave.title: ESA: Ariane 5 successfully launches Webb into orbit
brave.description: Arianespace's Ariane 5 rocket successfully launched the James Webb Space Telescope from the Guiana Space Centre on 25 December 2021.

brave.title: Nature: James Webb Space Telescope finally launches after decades of delays
brave.description: After more than two decades of development and numerous delays, the $10 billion James Webb Space Telescope launched on December 25, 2021.
